summary: Iteration 49 — Complimentary 7-day Premium on brand-new account. BACKEND (pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration49_complimentary_premium.py — 12/12 passed in 8.68s, JUnit /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_iteration49.xml). (1) /auth/register with a fresh throwaway email returns a session and the returned user doc has complimentary_used=true, trial_used=true, premium_source='complimentary'. GET /auth/me on that bearer immediately shows premium=true, premium_source='complimentary', complimentary_active=true, complimentary_days_left=7, trial_used=true, premium_until == complimentary_expires_at, and that timestamp is now+7d (6d23h < Δ < 7d5m). /membership/plans mirrors the same snapshot and trial_eligible=false. (2) NO RESTART: after a fresh /auth/login (new session token) and after a second fresh /auth/login (simulated reinstall / 2nd device, no local state), complimentary_started_at and complimentary_expires_at are byte-identical to the original — grant_welcome_premium is correctly a no-op when complimentary_used/trial_used/premium_until are set. (3) ONCE ONLY: with complimentary_expires_at/premium_until pushed into the past via Mongo, a re-login + /auth/me returns premium=false, complimentary_active=false; the stored premium_until/complimentary_started_at/complimentary_expires_at remain exactly as we set them (no re-grant). (4) EXPIRY → FREE + DATA INTACT: with expiry in the past, /insights/health-report and /insights/shopping-intelligence return 402 (gated); /tryon is 422 pre-gate from pydantic (person_image required) so we assert via the two header-only endpoints — explicitly reported as a backend code-review note so main agent is aware the gate order is 'parse body → enforce_limit', not blocking. Pre- vs post-expiry item/outfit/wear-log counts across the user's profiles are identical. (5) FULL ACCESS DURING PERIOD: /tryon returns 400 (missing person_image — past the premium gate), /insights/health-report, /insights/shopping-intelligence, /stylist/chat all return non-402 for the fresh complimentary account. (6) PURCHASE OVERRIDE: POST /membership/entitlement {active:true, entitlement_id:'Aureve', expires_at:null} on a complimentary account → premium_source becomes 'revenuecat', premium_until jumps >40y out, complimentary_active becomes false, premium stays true. (7) REVIEWER UNTOUCHED: pre- and post-login /auth/me snapshots of review@aureve.app show identical premium_until + premium_source='reviewer', no complimentary_* fields granted, and the Mongo doc is unchanged. (8) EXISTING FREE UNTOUCHED: a user whose complimentary_used/trial_used/premium_until have been stripped from Mongo gets NO grant on /auth/login or /auth/me — premium stays false, no complimentary fields appear. (9) /membership/trial on the complimentary account returns 400 ('already used your free trial.') — the old opt-in path is correctly closed. FRONTEND (web smoke @ 390x844): registering TEST_fe_comp*@aureve.local via login.tsx signup mode routed the user to /tour (first-run tour) then into (tabs); Home shows complimentary-pill reading 'Premium Access · 7 days remaining'; Profile shows complimentary-row with subtitle 'Complimentary — no charge, and it won't auto-renew' AND manage-subscription is HIDDEN; /premium renders premium-complimentary card ('Our welcome gift — the full app, free for 7 days.' + 'Nothing to cancel: it never becomes a paid subscription, and you'll simply move to the free tier unless you choose a plan below.') and start-trial-button is ABSENT. REGRESSION: logout → sign in as review@aureve.app / <set via the REVIEWER_PASSWORD environment variable> → Home shows NO complimentary-pill; Profile shows Premium badge + manage-subscription row and NO complimentary-row. 0 red screens, only pre-existing shadow*/pointerEvents style warnings. All throwaway accounts were DELETE /auth/account'd by the pytest fixture; review@aureve.app and user_testaura01 left exactly as documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.

minor.issue: Pydantic body validation (person_image required) runs BEFORE the premium gate, so a free user calling /tryon with an empty body gets 422, not 402. Not a correctness bug for this iteration (we proved the gate works via /insights/health-report and /insights/shopping-intelligence), but worth noting so UI copy / review-request expectations stay in sync — the gate still blocks the actual Premium feature; it just can't be verified by calling the endpoint with no payload.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:245-272 grant_welcome_premium correctly short-circuits if complimentary_used OR trial_used OR premium_until is already set — this is what makes reinstall / 2nd device / existing paid subscriber / existing free user all safe. It also sets trial_used=true, which is what causes POST /membership/trial to return 400 so there is no second trial path.

server.py:275-296 complimentary_state only reports complimentary_active=true when remaining>0 AND premium_source=='complimentary' — so the moment /membership/entitlement flips premium_source to 'revenuecat' the pill/row/card correctly disappear even though complimentary_expires_at is still in the future. Days-left rounds up (part-days read as a full day), so a brand-new account correctly reads '7 days remaining' for the whole first day.

server.py:413, 483, 568 grant_welcome_premium is called in all THREE brand-new-account paths (/auth/session when upserting a Google user, /auth/register for email, /auth/apple for the first-time Apple sign-in). On /auth/session and /auth/apple it is gated on 'new user doc only' — existing users just update name/picture — so a returning Google/Apple user cannot pick up a late grant. Confirmed by test_login_and_me_do_not_grant.

server.py:581-593 /auth/me spreads complimentary_state(user) into the response, so client reads complimentary_active / complimentary_days_left / complimentary_expires_at directly. /membership/plans does the same (line 641).

server.py:965-979 /membership/trial still exists (feature flag free_trial_enabled). For a complimentary account trial_used is true → returns 400 ('already used your free trial.'). That is the 'OLD OPT-IN TRIAL REFUSED' behaviour. Note: if FREE_TRIAL_ENABLED is false (current .env), /membership/trial would 403 for ANY account; for the complimentary case the correct guard is actually the trial_used check at line 970, which lands first on this account only when the flag is on. Either way the endpoint cannot grant a second trial.

AuthContext.tsx:27-29 exposes complimentary_active / complimentary_days_left / complimentary_expires_at on the user object, which is what the three UI surfaces consume. index.tsx:184 (complimentary-pill), profile.tsx:199 (complimentary-row), premium.tsx:134 (premium-complimentary) all gate on user?.complimentary_active, so a brand-new account sees them and a reviewer paid account does not — regression smoke confirmed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% web smoke — fresh signup → /tour → Home with complimentary-pill (7 days); Profile with complimentary-row (no manage-subscription); /premium with premium-complimentary card (no start-trial-button). Reviewer regression: no pill, no comp-row, manage-subscription present. Native Apple sign-in path is NOT exercised in the web preview (expo-apple-authentication is iOS-only) — confirmed in code review that /auth/apple calls grant_welcome_premium on first-time Apple sign-in (server.py:568) and the test for the identical shape on /auth/register is a reliable proxy. Google /auth/session relies on Emergent's demobackend and cannot be driven with a mock payload from here, but the same grant_welcome_premium branch is confirmed (server.py:413) and is identical semantically to the email path.

seed_data_creation: Each test fixture (fresh_account) creates a TEST_qa+comp*@aureve.local account via /auth/register and DELETEs it via /auth/account at teardown — any throwaway profiles, items, outfits, usage, sessions are wiped. The only direct Mongo writes are to those throwaway users (expire complimentary / strip premium fields) and are gone with the account. review@aureve.app and user_testaura01 were not touched — reviewer doc was snapshotted and asserted byte-identical pre/post login, user_testaura01 was never written to.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Complimentary 7-day Premium is fully wired. Backend: grant_welcome_premium(user_id) is called in /auth/register, /auth/session (only when upserting a NEW user), and /auth/apple (only on first-time apple_sub). It sets complimentary_started_at, complimentary_expires_at (now+7d), complimentary_used=true, trial_used=true, premium_until=expiry, premium_source='complimentary'. It is a no-op when complimentary_used OR trial_used OR premium_until is already set, so reinstalls, 2nd devices and existing paid subscribers are safe. complimentary_state(account) returns complimentary_active (true only when remaining>0 AND premium_source=='complimentary'), complimentary_days_left (ceil of remaining days), complimentary_expires_at. /auth/me and /membership/plans spread it into their response. Purchase precedence: POST /membership/entitlement sets premium_source='revenuecat', which makes complimentary_active fall to false even if complimentary_expires_at is still future. Old /membership/trial path is permanently blocked for complimentary accounts because trial_used=true is set at grant time. Frontend: three surfaces (home complimentary-pill, profile complimentary-row, premium premium-complimentary) all gate on user?.complimentary_active and share the 'Premium Access · N days remaining' format. Signup flow routes to /tour before (tabs), so UI tests must click Skip (or set aureve_tour_pending=false) before asserting the Home pill. Reviewer account (review@aureve.app / <set via the REVIEWER_PASSWORD environment variable>) is still premium with premium_source='reviewer' and shows manage-subscription, no comp-row. All credentials and seeded sample data at /app/memory/test_credentials.md are unchanged.
rca_of_issue: N/A — new-feature verification, not a bug fix. The one minor nit (POST /tryon returns 422 on empty body before the 402 gate because person_image is Pydantic-required) is pre-existing to this iteration and does not affect the complimentary feature's correctness. If main agent wants a clean 402 from /tryon for free users calling it with no payload, move the enforce_limit('tryon', user) call before the person_image check, or make person_image Optional[str]=None and return a 400/402 manually inside the handler.
